patterns.note: Full-bleed photographic imagery is used as the primary background for entire sections, often with minimal text overlays, creating distinct visual blocks.
Very large, bold, sans-serif headings are used to create strong visual impact, often appearing directly over full-bleed images or as prominent section titles.
A high-contrast black and white base is combined with rich, deep, earthy tones derived from the dominant colors of the full-bleed photographic section backgrounds.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to site navigation.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text and call-to-action, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width blocks, each often featuring a unique background image or solid color, creating clear visual separation between different themes or content types.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is positioned fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring it remains visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the page.

The hero section's background image is set to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content (text and call-to-action), creating a subtle depth effect. The foreground content scrolls normally, revealing more of the background image before it eventually scrolls out of view.
Each major content section utilizes a full-width, full-height image or a solid color as its background, with content overlaid. This creates a visually immersive and distinct block for each topic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, sans-serif headings (~3-5x body) with smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed sections and more compact grids for article listings.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, full-bleed photographic imagery as primary section backgrounds, often with minimal text overlays, creates an immersive and editorial experience. The bold, oversized typography directly integrated into these images is particularly impactful.
